name: Sasayaki
source:
He once had only the purest of thoughts. As a graduate student he had dreams, aspirations, and a desire to learn all things archaeology. But all of that came to an end when his ideals and hopes collided with the harsh reality. His desire to get back at the women who demeaned him opened the door to the whispering devil that now keeps on stirring the darkness inside him. Meet the high school humiliation AVG, packed full of twisted madness!

A literal hell on Earth--an all-girls school. Such a pity that, at the unwanted suggestion of a junior faculty member, he had to fill in for a professor there. Day after day, those pesky little bitches refuse to listen to anything that comes out of his mouth. But forget about the students; even the nagging teacher keeps on harassing him! No wonder the whisper in his head keeps asking for revenge. But will he succeed in fulfilling this burning desire, or will he die trying?

Well, you never know until you try it.

[Adapted from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1318&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
translation:
他曾经只有最纯洁的想法。作为研究生，他怀揣着梦想、抱负，以及学习一切考古学知识的渴望。但当他的理想和希望与残酷的现实碰撞时，一切都结束了。他想要报复那些贬低他的女性的欲望，打开了低语恶魔的大门，如今这恶魔不断搅动着他内心的黑暗。来体验这款充满扭曲疯狂的学园凌辱AVG吧！

人间地狱——一所女子学校。可惜的是，在一位年轻教员不情愿的建议下，他不得不去那里代课。日复一日，那些讨厌的小贱人们拒绝听他说的任何话。别说学生了，就连唠叨的老师也在不停地骚扰他！难怪他脑海中的低语一直要求复仇。但他能成功实现这个燃烧的欲望吗，还是会在尝试中死去？

嗯，不试怎么知道呢。

[改编自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1318&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
